# OPEN FOLD — client facts

## Network

- Name: OPEN FOLD
- Character: ongoing shared cultural-service identity for four independent publishing and handcraft spaces
- Location: Morrow Ward
- Membership: four independent equal-status spaces
- Descriptor: Independent print + making
- Member endorsement line: A member of OPEN FOLD
- Mark options: wordmark alone, or wordmark with an accompanying symbol

## Hierarchy by role

| role | primary level | secondary level |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Member door panel | member name, member role, member address | OPEN FOLD endorsement |
| Member information card | member name, member role, member address, member profile | OPEN FOLD endorsement |
| Network poster | OPEN FOLD, descriptor | four member names with roles at equal credit |
| Event poster | activity title, type, date, start and end, host name and address, partner name, entry and booking terms | OPEN FOLD mark |
| Event digital card | activity title, type, date, start and end, host name and address, partner name, entry and booking terms | OPEN FOLD mark |

## Member distinction cues

- Available cues: type, layout, pattern, illustration, photography, material texture
- Colour: supporting cue, alongside at least one other cue

## Event attribution

| activity | host | partner | event location |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Open Pages | Margin Room | Loop Bindery | 18 Alder Lane |
| Ink Together | Two Tone Press | Margin Room | 7 Alder Yard |
| Hands at Work | Form Table | Loop Bindery | 4 Foundry Walk |

- Credit wording: Hosted by / With
- Attendance terms for all three activities: Free entry; No booking required

## Core identity board content

- Mark uses: primary, single-colour, reversed
- Specified values: colour values, font and type roles, clear-space unit
- Endorsement examples: Margin Room, Form Table

## Physical applications

- Member door panel: 240 × 320 mm
- Printed-content inset: 15 mm on all four edges
- Network poster sizes: A2, A3, A4
- Event poster size: A3

## Image records

- door-panel-envelope.png: panel outline and printed-content inset
- margin-room-front.png: existing Margin Room frontage, timber frame and book display
- print-and-making-materials.png: paper, binding thread and clay atmosphere reference

## Related files

- 03-members.md: member IDs, names, roles, addresses, profiles
- 04-activities.md: activity IDs, titles, types, dates, start and end times, host IDs, partner IDs, entry and booking terms

steps.userMessage:
OPEN FOLD | A shared identity for independent print and making spaces

We run OPEN FOLD, an ongoing cultural-service network in Morrow Ward bringing together four independent spaces with equal standing: Margin Room, an independent bookshop at 18 Alder Lane; Two Tone Press, a print studio at 7 Alder Yard; Loop Bindery, a bookbinding studio at 31 Canal Row; and Form Table, a ceramic workshop at 4 Foundry Walk. We need a shared identity for joint publicity that also leaves each space recognisable. The mark may be a wordmark alone or a wordmark with a symbol. Print OPEN FOLD as the network name, "Independent print + making" as its descriptor and "A member of OPEN FOLD" as the member endorsement.

Member door panels are 240 × 320 mm, with a 15 mm inset for printed content. On these panels, the member name, role and address lead; the network endorsement sits below them. Network posters lead with OPEN FOLD and its descriptor, followed by all four members with their roles at equal credit. Member distinction uses at least one cue from type, layout, pattern, illustration, photography or material texture, with colour as a supporting cue. Event publicity leads with the activity and attendance details. Open Pages is a Small-press display and reading on 22 May 2027, 14:00–17:00, hosted by Margin Room at 18 Alder Lane with Loop Bindery. Ink Together is a Print open studio on 29 May 2027, 11:00–16:00, hosted by Two Tone Press at 7 Alder Yard with Margin Room. Hands at Work is Craft demonstrations on 5 June 2027, 13:00–17:00, hosted by Form Table at 4 Foundry Walk with Loop Bindery. Credit hosts as "Hosted by" and partners as "With". Print "Free entry" and "No booking required" on every event poster and digital card.

Audience: the four space owners and their publicity teams, choosing a shared identity and preparing door signage and event communications for young visitors.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md records the network wording, hierarchy and identity requirements. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists each deliverable's proportion, format and stage. 03-members.md supplies the four member records and profiles. 04-activities.md supplies the three activity records and attribution. door-panel-envelope.png defines the panel dimensions and content inset. margin-room-front.png records the existing bookshop frontage that receives the identity, including its recognisable timber frame and book display. print-and-making-materials.png provides atmosphere through paper, binding thread and clay.

Deliverables:
1. One final primary OPEN FOLD logo lockup
2. Two member door panels, one for Margin Room and one for Form Table, each with member name, role, address and network endorsement
3. One A2 network poster with OPEN FOLD, its descriptor and all four member names and roles
4. One A3 Open Pages event poster with activity title, type, date, start and end times, host, location, partner and attendance terms
5. One Open Pages digital card with the same activity information and attribution as its event poster

Acceptance:
- Use the final primary OPEN FOLD logo consistently on both door panels, the network poster, the Open Pages poster and the digital card.
- Set both door panels at 240 × 320 mm with printed content inside the 15 mm inset; lead with each member's name, role and address, followed by "A member of OPEN FOLD". Distinguish Margin Room and Form Table through at least one of type, layout, pattern, illustration, photography or material texture, alongside colour.
- Lead the A2 network poster with OPEN FOLD and "Independent print + making"; give Margin Room, Two Tone Press, Loop Bindery and Form Table equal credit, each with the role stated in 03-members.md.
- Lead the Open Pages poster and digital card with Open Pages, Small-press display and reading, 22 May 2027 and 14:00–17:00; print "Hosted by" before Margin Room, 18 Alder Lane as the location, "With" before Loop Bindery, and both "Free entry" and "No booking required".

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
